records.title: A Letter Never Sent
records.briefing: Find a sealed letter in the abandoned posthouse of Ghost Town.
records.completionText: Behind the postmaster's desk you find a letter of forgiveness, still waiting for its recipient.

records.title: The Herbalist's Keepsake
records.briefing: Search Enchanted Forest for an herbalist's silver locket.
records.completionText: A locket hangs from a thorn branch above a patch of moonwort. Its tiny portrait is unharmed.

records.title: The Broken Waystone
records.briefing: Examine the fractured waystone in Mystic Ruins and copy its lost inscription.
records.completionText: Rubbing charcoal over the stone reveals an older road, erased from every modern map.

records.title: A Lantern for the Lost
records.briefing: Defeat the Bonewalker disturbing the memorial lanterns at Forgotten Cemetery.
records.completionText: The restless bones settle. You relight a lantern beside a gravestone whose name has worn away.

records.title: The Oasis Promise
records.briefing: Retrieve a traveler's medicine cache from Desert Oasis.
records.completionText: The wrapped medicine is still dry beneath the well stones. Someone kept their promise to leave it here.

records.title: A Warden's Last Watch
records.briefing: Recover a missing warden's badge from Barren Plains for the Ironward Company.
records.completionText: You find the badge beside a repaired milepost. Even stranded, the warden kept the road marked.

records.title: The Unwritten Chapter
records.briefing: Retrieve an unfinished manuscript from Enchanted Library for the Lantern Scholars.
records.completionText: The manuscript ends in mid-sentence. Marginal notes reveal the missing argument the scholars need.

records.title: The Honest Counterfeit
records.briefing: Confront the Outlaw forging merchant seals at Bandit Hideout.
records.completionText: The outlaw's dies expose the forged seals, but an honest apprentice's name on the receipts clears one suspect.

records.title: A Seal Without a Name
records.briefing: Find the hidden witness testimony in Abandoned Castle for the Crownward Order.
records.completionText: Inside an unmarked seal case lies testimony that names the courier's betrayer, not the courier himself.

records.title: The Navigator's Debt
records.briefing: Defeat the Mimic guarding a navigator's instruments in Crystal Caverns.
records.completionText: You recover a battered compass. Its dedication proves Oren never forgot the crew who saved him.

records.title: The Winter Song
records.briefing: Find a musician's songbook beneath the old camp in Frozen Tundra.
records.completionText: A waxed pouch protects the last verse. The song ends with a homecoming instead of a farewell.

records.title: The Hollow Tree
records.briefing: Search the hollow elder tree in Whispering Woods for a child's carved bird.
records.completionText: The wooden bird rests in a nest of moss. Its wings still turn when the wind catches them.

records.title: The Empty Granary
records.briefing: Defeat the Rat Swarm guarding the last grain sacks in Ghost Town.
records.completionText: You clear the granary and discover enough sound grain to help the refugees through another week.

records.title: A Memory in Glass
records.briefing: Retrieve a crystal recording from Crystal Caverns.
records.completionText: Held to the light, the crystal echoes a miner's final directions to a sealed, safe passage.

records.title: The Ruined Oath
records.briefing: Defeat the Ancient Legionary keeping watch at Haunted Ruins.
records.completionText: The legionary finally lowers its blade. Beneath its shield is the oath it guarded for a forgotten kingdom.

records.title: The Warning Bell
records.briefing: Find the cracked warning bell beside Barren Plains' abandoned watchpost.
records.completionText: The bell's clapper is intact. The Ironward smith can make the watchpost's warning heard again.

records.title: The Apprentice's First Error
records.briefing: Recover an apprentice's misplaced field notes in Enchanted Forest.
records.completionText: The notes contain more crossed-out guesses than answers. The final page shows the apprentice was learning.

records.title: A Very Small Debt
records.briefing: Find a street vendor's missing account book at Desert Oasis.
records.completionText: The account book records years of meals given on credit. The Consortium can now repay that quiet generosity.

records.title: The Fallen Banner
records.briefing: Retrieve the courier escort's banner in Whispering Woods.
records.completionText: The torn banner bears every escort's stitched initials. Ariandel, The Royal Capital will remember their service.

records.title: The Last Beacon
records.briefing: Recover the expedition's beacon lens from Pirate Cove.
records.completionText: The lens is hidden among worthless glass. Once returned to Velmora, it can guide the next expedition home.

records.title: The Long Watch
records.briefing: Walk the outer watch with an Ironward patrol and clear the outlaws shadowing the Barren Plains road.
records.completionText: The patrol returns with every wagon accounted for. The roadwarden marks your name beside hers on the roster.

records.title: A Shelf for the City
records.briefing: Recover a missing folio from the Enchanted Library before the Lantern archive loses its only copy.
records.completionText: The folio is damp but legible. Iven shelves it himself and leaves the reading room open for you.

records.title: The Honest Ledger
records.briefing: Recover the stolen Silverthread ledger from the Bandit Hideout before the market opens.
records.completionText: The ledger is intact. Tessa reads the first page aloud to the market and leaves your name in the margin.

records.title: The Crown's Quiet Errand
records.briefing: Escort a Crownward clerk through the Cursed Citadel and recover the seal she is carrying.
records.completionText: The clerk delivers the seal and records your service without ceremony. The order's trust is not given twice.

records.title: The Tidebound Charter
records.briefing: Recover the Tidebound charter from the Underwater Temple before the next crossing is licensed.
records.completionText: The charter comes up dry in its wax case. Nella reads it on the ferry and adds your name to the passenger roll.
